title: A session's page now fits a phone

owner_note.text: At phone width, a session's page now has a one-line cost and state bar (tap it for every figure) and one row of tabs: Overview · Timeline · Chat · Tasks · More ▾. The Timeline's first events now show on the first screen, with no inner scroll box. I chose to open the Timeline on a phone at its oldest event, so the tabs stay in view; the alternative is newest first, a one-line change.
